digest.component_or_area: Plan lifecycle intents and pre-effect selection/exclusion
propositions: Versioned lifecycle intents (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity) must be modeled with version equal to enclosing Observation.version, carrying no independent counter.
Inter-ticket dependencies for create-before-link and parent-before-child prerequisites must be explicit plan dependencies, with blocked prerequisites deferred and tagged dependency_deferred.
Selection, filter, mode cap, and global safety limit decisions must be applied pre-effect during planning, each producing a distinguishable deferral reason (scope_deferred or safety_aborted).
Tombstone, index-lag, moved-key, impossible-link, and partial-snapshot cases must map to deterministic skipped dispositions via ticket-sourced tables.
No lifecycle intent or remote effect eligibility occurs until all global selection/limit/filter decisions are applied during planning.
plan_pass signature/semantics must be updated to accept and apply pre-effect selection/filter/mode-cap/limit exclusion with reason tagging, remaining pure with zero I/O.
